name: Degraded Condenser Vacuum
description: Condenser cooling effectiveness degrades over two minutes (e.g. loss of circulating-water flow or air in-leakage). Backpressure rises, turbine output falls, and eventually the high-backpressure turbine trip actuates, followed by the reactor trip.
briefing: Condenser performance decays starting at t+15 s. Track backpressure and generator output. Decide whether to reduce load pre-emptively.
learning_objectives: The condenser as the normal ultimate heat sink and its effect on cycle efficiency
A slowly developing process fault versus a step fault
